package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

type ReadinessReconciliationResult struct {
	Schema   string                          `json:"schema"`
	Instance domain.TaskInstance             `json:"instance"`
	Receipt  domain.LearningReadinessReceipt `json:"receipt"`
}

func (runtime *Runtime) ReconcileStepReadiness(ctx context.Context, studentID, instanceID, stepID, idempotencyKey string) (ReadinessReconciliationResult, int, error) {
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(studentID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(instanceID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(idempotencyKey) || stepID == "" {
		return ReadinessReconciliationResult{}, 400, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	unlock := runtime.lockInstance(instanceID)
	defer unlock()

	instance, err := runtime.Repository.GetInstance(ctx, studentID, instanceID)
	if err != nil {
		return ReadinessReconciliationResult{}, statusFor(err), err
	}
	if instance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceInProgress {
		return ReadinessReconciliationResult{}, 409, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	var stepIndex = -1
	for index := range instance.Steps {
		if instance.Steps[index].ID == stepID {
			stepIndex = index
			break
		}
	}
	if stepIndex < 0 {
		return ReadinessReconciliationResult{}, 404, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	step := instance.Steps[stepIndex]
	if !step.Required || (step.Status != "LEARNING_REQUIRED" && step.Status != "AVAILABLE") {
		return ReadinessReconciliationResult{}, 409, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	commandDigest, err := domain.CommandDigest(struct {
		Schema         string `json:"schema"`
		StudentID      string `json:"student_id"`
		TaskInstanceID string `json:"task_instance_id"`
		StepID         string `json:"step_id"`
	}{"practice-step-readiness-reconcile.v1", studentID, instanceID, stepID})
	if err != nil {
		return ReadinessReconciliationResult{}, 500, err
	}
	if _, err := runtime.Repository.CreateOrLoadCommandReceipt(ctx, idempotencyKey, instance.ID, "readiness-reconcile", commandDigest); err != nil {
		return ReadinessReconciliationResult{}, statusFor(err), err
	}
	receipt, err := runtime.Planner.ReconcileReadiness(ctx, ports.ReconcileLearningReadiness{
		IdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey, TaskInstanceID: instance.ID, StudentID: instance.StudentID,
		TaskRevisionID: instance.TaskRevisionID, RevisionDigest: instance.TaskRevisionDigest,
		RouteID: instance.LearningRoute.ID, RouteDigest: instance.LearningRoute.RouteDigest, StepID: step.ID,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return ReadinessReconciliationResult{}, statusFor(err), err
	}
	if !domain.ValidLearningReadinessReceipt(receipt) || receipt.TaskInstanceID != instance.ID || receipt.StudentID != instance.StudentID ||
		receipt.TaskRevisionID != instance.TaskRevisionID || receipt.TaskRevisionDigest != instance.TaskRevisionDigest ||
		receipt.RouteID != instance.LearningRoute.ID || receipt.RouteDigest != instance.LearningRoute.RouteDigest || receipt.StepID != step.ID {
		return ReadinessReconciliationResult{}, 503, domain.ErrDependency
	}
	if step.ReadinessReceipt != nil && step.ReadinessIdempotencyKey == idempotencyKey && step.ReadinessReceipt.ID != receipt.ID {
		return ReadinessReconciliationResult{}, 503, domain.ErrDependency
	}
	if step.ReadinessReceipt == nil || step.ReadinessReceipt.ID != receipt.ID || step.ReadinessIdempotencyKey != idempotencyKey {
		instance.Steps[stepIndex].ReadinessReceipt = &receipt
		instance.Steps[stepIndex].ReadinessIdempotencyKey = idempotencyKey
		if receipt.Decision == "READY" && instance.Steps[stepIndex].Status == "LEARNING_REQUIRED" {
			instance.Steps[stepIndex].Status = "AVAILABLE"
		}
		instance.UpdatedAt = runtime.now()
		setCurrentStep(&instance)
		instance, err = runtime.Repository.SaveInstance(ctx, instance)
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
				return ReadinessReconciliationResult{}, 409, domain.ErrConflict
			}
			return ReadinessReconciliationResult{}, statusFor(err), err
		}
	}
	return ReadinessReconciliationResult{Schema: "practice-step-readiness-reconciliation.v1", Instance: instance.PublicProjection(), Receipt: receipt}, 200, nil
}
